locations.note: Home base of the trilogy; the mind-swap mystery starts among Capri's real streets and residents.
One of the new mainland settings, photographed on the Amalfi coast.
A hillside village above Amalfi used as one of the game's photographic locations.
The cliffside town of Positano is among the Amalfi coast sites visited.
The small island of Procida in the Bay of Naples is one of the new locations.
Many sites in Naples appear as the series expands beyond Capri for the first time.

routes.name: Nick Freuds
routes.note: Sent hopping by a teleporting fridge from Anacapri round the Bay of Naples, Nick gathers light crystals on Procida, at Pogerola's waterfall, in Amalfi and Positano, and mends the space-time rip beneath Naples before going home.
